thread_message.description: One turn of a Member conversation.

conversation_start_request.description: Sent backend→agent to open a conversation with one Farmer Member over a Channel: who, on which channel-qualified contact, about what, with the questions the conversation walks through. The agent asks the first question over the Channel, then pauses (checkpointed) until the Member replies.

request_id.description: The parent Request's ID; empty when the conversation is not (yet) tied to one.

contact.description: Channel-qualified contact point from the roster, e.g. 'whatsapp:+353860000001'.

resume_url.description: The Member's resumable link (no account — the token is the capability); appended to Channel messages. Empty string when the deployment has no public URL.

conversation_response.description: The agent's answer for a conversation turn (start or reply): delivery acknowledgement, the conversation status, the full thread, and the answers gathered so far.

delivered.description: Whether the agent's latest Channel message was acknowledged by the medium. A reply is only ever reported as sent once the medium has it.

status.description: awaiting_member: paused on a checkpoint, waiting for the Member. completed: all questions answered (or the Member said done). stopped: the Member declined to continue.
